about: The program and form names a line must never split at their hyphen (H- then 1B). One pattern: src/lib/programNames.ts builds the site's from it (KeepWhole, the MDX plugin) and scripts/phone_sweep.mjs builds its split check from it. A name ends at a non-word character, never at a hyphen and a digit, so the start of a DOL case number (G-100-24001-000002) is never a form. A trailing lowercase s (H-1Bs) stays with the name.
